comment: Output layout files and the Penpot boards in each (UI-D11). A board is given by its number (the name must start with 'NN / ') or by its exact name. Run: python -I tools/penpot_export.py <snapshot.json> --manifest tools/penpot_layouts.json --out-dir data/ui/layout

files.description: Pause menu (14), save dialog and its states (15-21), overwrite (22), before exit (23, 78) and load game (72).
Game summary: the name that stays in history (24-26) and the extinct line (27, 73, 74).
Court (30-32) and the candidates for a position (75, 76).
Game goal window and change of goal: boards 45-48.
Start of a custom dynasty and the check of the beginning of the story: boards 49-55.
Dynasty chronicle, journal and event settings: boards 65-69.
